name: My Mom's Bestfriend!
source:
"My Mom's Bestfriend!" is a visual novel that follows the story of a young college student returning to his hometown after finishing the semester. The protagonist is excited to reunite with his mother and catch up on all the missed moments. However, a surprising twist awaits as the protagonist's childhood crush, Hanna, who is also his mother's best friend, makes an unexpected visit.​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
“我妈妈最好的朋友！”是一部视觉小说，讲述了一名年轻大学生学期结束后回到家乡的故事。主角很高兴能与母亲重聚，并追忆所有错过的时刻。然而，当主人公儿时暗恋的汉娜（同时也是他母亲最好的朋友）意外造访时，一个令人惊讶的转折正在等待着他。​

[来自F95Zone]
